Name: Arrbyte's Birds for Ornithologists Guild
Author: Arrbyte
Description:
[size=4][u][b]Content[/b][/u][/size]
[size=3]Meet several wild and domestic variants of common loved pets in Stardew Valley![/size]

[i]Featuring in many colors[/i][size=3]:[/size]
[size=3]- Zebra finches [/size]
[size=3]- Canaries[/size]
[size=3]- Lovebirds  

[/size][size=3]While a bit rarer, with a bit of luck you might spot one or six of them in the desert or your own local forest or farm. [b][size=4][img]https://piskel-imgstore-b.appspot.com/img/9efbd623-295a-11ef-882a-f122ed534c40.gif[/img][/size][/b][/size]


[u][b][size=4]Credits[/size][/b]
[/u][size=3]Thanks to [b]Ivy[/b] for the core mod and allowing me to use your assets as guidance.
Thanks to [b]MadDenim[/b] for refining the pixel art.
Thanks to several of my birds to provide the sounds, everything is self recorded and edited. 

Thank you too. I am very happy about the amount of bird enthusiasts here. Haha! [/size]
﻿[img]https://piskel-imgstore-b.appspot.com/img/345e01a1-2f15-11ef-8619-4fcdf78163f8.gif[/img]


[u][b][size=4]Languages[/size][/b][/u]
[size=3]English[/size]
[size=3]German[/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26763][size=3]Chinese by arcturusyu[/size]

[/url]﻿
[size=3]Feel free to upload your own translation. PM me if you do, so I can post it here if you want to.
Warning! At least for now I am still updating the game though, just a bit slow :)
[/size][img]https://piskel-imgstore-b.appspot.com/img/7cdf54e1-295c-11ef-8f87-f122ed534c40.gif[/img]
[size=2]And note:
I have researched with the best of my abilities and taken as many different sources together to make the facts come together. Since I feature a few colors, each have their own "fun fact" they do not repeat. But I still cannot guarantee for 100% correctness in fun facts and "subspecies category".
Some colors are a bit hard for me to identify which species they were bred from and are probably hybrids. If you have any suggestions, just comment and I gladly address them.[/size]


[u][b][size=4]Requirements in 1.6[/size][/b]
[/u][font=Arial][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14510]Bird overhaul - Ornithologist's Guild - 1.6 ready[/url] by [/size][/font][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/81086143][font=Arial][size=3]ivylovesbirds[/size][/font]
[/url][b]

[u][size=4]In real life:[/size]
[/u][/b][size=3]If the thought of free birds is making you happy, please consider giving some money or help to your local bird rescue or shelter. [/size]
[size=3]The wild bird rescues can be tricky to find, the visibility often is rather bad. The workload in a wild bird rescue is quite high, and we are always looking for helpers too. While this mod pack features common pet-birds, I still promise you your local wild birds are just as cute. :3[/size]
